commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text:
She asks how her suffering might be ended.

My heart, I haven’t the power to find it. Whatever it may be, find out and tell me one medicine for this sickness that nothing relieves. “Any at all” means even something that gives up modesty, which is worth more than life.
